personality_one_liner: A clean, trustworthy, and highly native marketplace interface prioritizing content, clear community-driven commerce, and reliable order tracking.

spacing.rule: Generous comfortable padding; never cramp interactive elements. Cards use md (12px) margin between them.

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrolling content.
Use on the bottom tab bar.
Use on floating action buttons (FABs) and bottom-sheet headers.
dont's: Do not use on regular list rows or form fields.
Avoid on high-density data screens or purely functional settings pages.

screens.name: Beranda (Home)
screens.purpose: Discover the active community, browse local sellers, and find products.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for top categories and store cards.
states.empty: Illustration of a neighborhood with 'Belum ada toko di komunitas ini' (No stores in this community yet) + 'Undang Penjual' CTA.
states.error: 'Gagal memuat komunitas' (Failed to load community) + Retry button.

screens.layout: Header with active community name/location and a prominent search bar. Below header: horizontal scroll for categories/filters. Main content: vertical feed of seller profiles/store cards with featured product thumbnails. Floating Action Button for active orders if any.

screens.name: Pesanan (Orders)
screens.purpose: Track active orders with a live status timeline and view order history.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty delivery bag with 'Belum ada pesanan aktif' + CTA to browse.

screens.layout: Top Tabs (Aktif, Riwayat). Aktif tab: Card-based list of active orders with a mini live status timeline (progress indicator from MENUNGGU_KONFIRMASI to SELESAI), countdown timers (e.g., 04:59 Menunggu Konfirmasi Penjual), and map snapshot if 'Sedang Diantar'. Prominent 'Chat Penjual' button.

screens.name: Chat
screens.purpose: Order-linked messaging between buyer and seller with photo sharing.

states.empty: Illustration with 'Belum ada pesan' (No messages yet).

screens.layout: Standard list of active chat threads. Inside chat: sticky header with order context/status badge, message bubbles (right for self, left for seller), input area with attachment (photo) icon. Input disabled when order status is SELESAI.

screens.name: Titip di Rumah (Proof of Delivery Capture)
screens.purpose: Allow sellers/deliverers to capture two mandatory proof photos when leaving orders at the door.

states.error: Upload failed toast + retry on image block.

screens.layout: Full-screen modal. Shows order details, two large photo upload/capture square slots ('Foto Paket di Lokasi' & 'Foto Nomor Rumah/Patokan'). Submit button enabled only when both photos are present.

neighborhood_aerial.alt: Aerial view of a local neighborhood community

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement navigation using 4 bottom tabs: Beranda, Pesanan, Chat, and Akun.
Strictly follow the color palette provided (green primary, orange accent). Do NOT use any blue, purple, or indigo shades anywhere in the app, even for system defaults or interactive states.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all text elements. Cap font weights at 500 max (do not use semi-bold, bold, etc., rely on size for hierarchy).

For the active order timeline in the 'Pesanan' screen, implement a vertical or horizontal progress sequence matching the states provided in the problem statement (MENUNGGU_KONFIRMASI -> DIKONFIRMASI -> SEDANG_DIPROSES -> SIAP_DIANTAR -> SEDANG_DIANTAR -> DISERAHKAN/DITITIPKAN -> MENUNGGU_PENYELESAIAN -> SELESAI).
Integrate a live countdown timer component for time-sensitive actions (e.g., 5-min seller confirmation), styled clearly to drive urgency.
All copy and UI labels MUST be in Bahasa Indonesia (e.g., Keranjang, Beranda, Titip di Rumah).
When displaying images as hero banners or over text, ALWAYS apply a top-to-bottom vertical gradient scrim to ensure text readability.
Implement haptics on major interactions like adding to cart, order status updates, and submitting proof of delivery.
